# Claim Receipts

> A GitHub Action and CLI that checks a pull request's claims against evidence: CI results for "tests pass", the issue tracker for "fixes #N", the diff and repository for named files and functions, and npm/PyPI for newly added packages (missing, placeholder, typo-squat, brand-new, or barely downloaded). Deterministic: no AI model makes any verdict.

## Use
- GitHub Action: `uses: equinoxaifinance-rgb/claim-receipts@v0` on `pull_request` events, with `pull-requests: write`, `checks: read`, `statuses: read`, `issues: read`, `actions: read`, `contents: read`.
- CLI for agents: `npx github:equinoxaifinance-rgb/claim-receipts owner/repo#123 --json`. Exit code 1 when claims are contradicted. Run it on your own pull request before reporting the work as done.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): what it checks, settings, limits
- [SECURITY](SECURITY.md)
- Hosted GitHub App (no workflow file, per-agent proof-rate scorecard; free on public and private repositories): https://github.com/apps/claim-receipts
